_description: Single source of truth for the CoinCync testnet fleet topology. Every node listed here will have every other node added to its --addnode dial list via scripts/render-systemd-unit.sh + scripts/sync-fleet-config.sh. When a node is added, removed, or has its IP changed: (1) edit this file, (2) run scripts/sync-fleet-config.sh, (3) verify every node converges. See docs/operations/fleet-config.md (TODO) for the runbook.
_last_changed: 2026-06-18 — full fleet inventory captured during the post-stall hardening pass; miner added (was missing from every node's dial list, root cause of the 2026-06-17/18 stall).
_rpc_bind_policy: Per-host RPC bind address. 127.0.0.1 means loopback-only (RPC only reachable from localhost; safer default; assumes nginx or stunnel for any public exposure). 0.0.0.0 means listen on all interfaces (public RPC). Keep loopback unless the host is intentionally serving public RPC (api node has nginx; seed1/seed2 historically served fleet members directly).

deactivated._description: Nodes that were once in the fleet but no longer participate. Kept here for historical reference; NOT added to addnode lists. Re-activate by moving back into `nodes` and re-running sync-fleet-config.sh.
